$comment: Written by npm run schemas from core/schema. Change the definition there, not this file.
title: The claims XenoNet reads from Codex's ID token
description: The claims in the ID token of ~/.codex/auth.json, decoded without verifying: who is signed in, the workspace, the plan and when. XenoNet reads auth_mode, whether there's an API key, and the token's claims, and never keeps a token. The claims carry no version, so the newest schema reads them.

auth_time.description: When you signed in, in epoch seconds
